per_case_note: PER-CASE floor, added 2026-07-30. The aggregate above cannot do the job it was given: the battery is 20 prompts, so verdict@1 moves in steps of 0.05 -- the same size as the gate's own tolerance -- and the cassette is deterministic, so this is lost information rather than sampling noise. A change that fixes one body and breaks another reads as no change at all. That is not hypothetical: measured on this date, hybrid (mobile manipulator) had gone 1.0 -> 0.0, BOTH cases lost, while animal gained one, for a net -0.05 that the tolerance absorbed exactly. See task #246. The map below therefore records what is credible TODAY as a floor that may not shrink; the `known_regressions` list names cases the aggregate baseline says SHOULD pass and which do not, so they are debt rather than blessed.
